skus.title: NOVA Cotton Pad Holder with Lid, Clear Round Storage
skus.item_highlights: Side opening; removable top; for round cotton pads up to 6 cm; pads not included.
bullets: SIDE OPENING FOR ACCESS: Take a cotton pad through the opening without lifting the entire stack out. Check the pad size before filling the holder; the opening is intended for round cotton pads up to 6 cm across.
CLEAR STORAGE AT A GLANCE: See the remaining stack through the clear PS plastic body. Keep the cotton pad holder beside your usual skincare items so you can check the supply as part of your routine.

LID FOR THE TOP OPENING: Lift the lid to refill the cotton round dispenser from above, then put it back after loading. The side opening stays accessible; this design is storage for daily use, with a removable top.

CHECK YOUR ROUND PAD SIZE: This holder is designed around round cotton pads up to 6 cm in diameter. Compare the pads you already use with that limit before ordering; oversized rounds and folded wipes need another fit.

ONE HOLDER WITH A LID: The set contains one clear body and one removable lid. Cotton pads are not included. Choose a spot that leaves the side opening clear so the holder remains accessible next to your other vanity items.
skus.description:
Use this cotton pad holder to give a stack of round cotton pads a defined place on your vanity. The clear PS plastic body lets you see what remains, while the removable lid provides access from the top for refilling. A side opening offers a separate place to take a pad during your skincare routine.

Before choosing a spot, leave room around the side opening. Compare the diameter of the cotton pads you use with the 6 cm limit in this example. The holder is intended for round pads; larger rounds, folded wipes and other shapes should be checked separately rather than assumed to fit.

To refill the cotton round dispenser, lift the lid and lower the pads into the body. Replace the lid after loading and use the side opening for daily access. This arrangement keeps refilling and everyday access in separate places, so the product description tells you what each opening is for.

The package contains one clear holder and one removable lid. Cotton pads and the other vanity items shown in an example setting are not included. This description focuses on product type, access, material, compatibility and package contents; use those details to compare it with the space and pads you already have.

description.translation_zh:
用这款收纳盒为圆形化妆棉安排固定位置。透明 PS 塑料盒体可查看余量，顶部盖子用于补充，侧面开口用于日常取用。

打开盖子，从上方装入棉片，再盖好；日常从侧面开口取用。这样把补充和取用位置分开，便于理解每个开口的用途。

套装含一个透明盒体和一个可拆盖子，不含化妆棉及其他摆拍用品。可根据产品类型、取用方式、材质、尺寸边界和包装内容，判断是否适合自己的使用环境。
